syllabusTopics: Creating a Spring Boot project — Spring Initializr, Maven vs Gradle, project structure
Filters, interceptors, and middleware — when to use each
Spring Data JPA — @Entity, @Repository, JPQL, derived queries, pagination
Lazy vs eager loading — N+1 problem, @EntityGraph, fetch joins
Transaction management — @Transactional, propagation levels, isolation levels, rollback rules
Spring Security — authentication vs authorization, filter chain, JWT integration, OAuth2
